parsed.why: No trans-specific law or border practice, but extreme societal hostility (~85-96% disapproval), police who leak, refuse to investigate and fail to protect Pride, unsolved mob killing of a gender-nonconforming teen, and prison violence against perceived LGBTQ — no working recourse.

Same-sex conduct legal, no trans-specific offence, no documented police or border targeting, and a documented accepted third-gender community. Gaps are resident-facing (no LGR without surgery, no anti-discrimination/hate-crime law); conservative LGB opinion is secondary.

Penal Code articles reach the visitor's conduct with up to three years, no LGR or registration, no recourse; dated 2010 party raids, armed-group sodomy executions in control zones, constrained capital life — but recent enforcement undocumented and one hunting claim debunked.

Universal-exposure border screening of appearance against passport sex: 2025 genital X-rays, repeated refusals and deportations over a decade; gender nonconformity criminalised with visitor prosecutions, head-shaving and medication confiscation in custody. State is the perpetrator.

State morality regime: flogging and death penalty for sexual conduct, executions, forced anal tests, rape of a trans detainee, official advisories restricting trans visibility, outing military IDs and coerced surgery — organized state targeting with no recourse.
